title: finding(sdui-parser): the BaseSchema-member family after objectui#11008 — `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn` and `testId` still draw a false `unknown-prop` on every type, and the generated JSX types (`SduiBaseProps`) still refuse `bind` and `hidden`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect family with named sites, class (a), filed as ONE closure card. `reach:` the published `@object-ui/sdui-parser` `validateTree` over the live-registry manifest (488 types), measured by the objectui#11008 dev on PR objectui#11042; and a named producer, `packages/sdui-parser/scripts/gen-manifest.ts`, whose generated `.d.ts` refuses two declared keys (a `tsc` probe). Reader: triage first (grade and route; objectui#11008 was `domain:ui`), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, from the dev report on objectui#11008. ⛔ Not graded here. Serial behind PR objectui#11042 (same file, same set).

## Member 1: base-prop keys the parser still calls unknown (mechanical, the objectui#11008 fix)

Measured at PR objectui#11042's head: `visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn` and `testId` each draw `unknown-prop` on 488 of 488 registered types and are declared by 0 registrations, while `SchemaRenderer`'s hide chain reads `visibleWhen` / `hiddenOn` for every node and strips and re-emits `testId`. The same mechanical fix as `bind` / `hidden`: join `BASE_PROPS`. Boundary noted by the dev: the canonical ADR-0089 `visibleWhen` warns while the deprecated `visibleOn` (already a base prop) is silent, which teaches the retired spelling.

## Member 2: subset-declared members (a decision, not a mechanical add)

`BASE_PROPS` membership skips the declared-input lookup, type check included. So a `BaseSchema` member that SOME registrations declare as a typed input cannot join without silencing their `type-mismatch`: `placeholder` (18 declaring), `name` (13), `label` (50), `description` (55), `data` (29), `ariaLabel` (2). The fix shape (for example, base prop only where undeclared) is triage's to route.

## Member 3: the generated JSX base props

`SduiBaseProps` (`packages/sdui-parser` `codegen.ts`, written into `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` by `scripts/gen-manifest.ts`) is a second hand-kept base-prop list, without `bind` or `hidden`. Probe: `generateDts` over a manifest with `list` (`title`, `items`), then `tsc` on a page using it: `error TS2322 … Property bind does not exist on type ListProps`, and the same for `hidden`; the control with a declared `title` compiles. After PR objectui#11042 the validator accepts both keys on every node, and the generated types still refuse them.

## Direction (for triage)

- One list, not two: derive `BASE_PROPS` and `SduiBaseProps` from one source (the `BaseSchema` members the parser treats as base), so the next member cannot drift between them.
- Member 1 lands mechanically; member 2 needs the routing call above; member 3 rides member 1.
- The objectstack save-gate copy of `validate.ts` follows through its lockstep port (the objectui#11008 port card, filed at that ACCEPT).

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated issues and PRs of objectui (down to #9547) and of objectstack (down to #8753), open and closed, were listed through REST and grepped locally, read 2026-09-29: `BASE_PROPS` 4 hits in objectui (objectui#10217, a seat post; objectui#11008; objectui#11009; PR objectui#10484), none about these keys; `visibleWhen` near `unknown-prop` 0; `SduiBaseProps` / `sdui-intrinsics` 7, none about `bind` / `hidden`. Control: `unknown-prop` alone gives 18.

Dedupe words: `BASE_PROPS` `visibleWhen` `hiddenOn` `testId` · validateTree false unknown-prop BaseSchema member · `SduiBaseProps` bind · sdui-intrinsics TS2322 bind

<sub>`domain:ui` seat 2 · finding · 2026-09-29</sub>
